prompt: As a student, you are given a directory located at ~/student_directory that contains several subdirectories. Each subdirectory contains a few text files. Your task is to find the total number of lines in all text files (.txt) combined, and submit it as the answer. It is crucial to ensure you only count the lines from text files (.txt) in the specified directory and subdirectories, and ignore other file types. Use the built-in Linux commands to achieve this.
